stages.name: Plan
stages.does: Turns the ask into searches, hashtags and a keep/drop rule.

output.NAME: mijo-mom-scroll
output.TITLE: What the Mijo Mom Watches for Fun
output.WHOSE_SCROLL: A Latina mom in her 40s-50s who scrolls for family comedy, nostalgia, novela drama, and throwback music — never for skincare or fixing a problem.
YOUTUBE_SEARCHES: musica de los 90 en espanol mix
output.KEEP_RULE: A post belongs only if it's comedy, nostalgia, music, novela-drama clips, or family-relatable content she'd send to her comadre — pure entertainment, nothing about skin or a fix.
output.DROP_RULE: Drop parenting-tip videos, skincare/acne routines, product reviews, and 'how to help your teen' advice — these ride the same hashtags but are problem-solving content, not entertainment.

stages.name: Pull
stages.does: Runs every search on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube; turns away ads, old posts and small posts at the door.

stages.name: Sift
stages.does: Sorts every new post into a lane: entertainment, educational, selling or junk. Only the first two stay.
